limitations: This is a task-local prototype and is not wired into production generation or approval metadata.
Evidence covers the four declared settings at one retained seed, not every possible input.
Finite demonstrations eliminate the three declared parameter rivals, not every imaginable rule.

anchor_mode.meaning: align the matching source cell or the template bounding-box origin to each productive dot

canvas_mode.meaning: start from an all-4 canvas or preserve the input before stamping

parameters.input_constraints: generated episodes use three uniquely anchored templates, two productive dots per template, and retained inputs for which all four settings yield distinct outputs

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let ((h (rows g))
               (w (cols g))
               (bg 4))
           (let ((comps (objects-multicolor g bg)))
             (let ((shapes (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) comps))
                   (dots (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) comps)))
               (let ((shape-cells (flatmap (lambda (s)
                                             (map (lambda (cell) (list s cell))
                                                  (obj-cells s)))
                                           shapes)))
                 (reduce (lambda (acc dot)
                           (let ((dp (fst (obj-cells dot)))
                                 (dc (at g
                                         (fst (fst (obj-cells dot)))
                                         (snd (fst (obj-cells dot))))))
                             (let ((matches (filter (lambda (m)
                                                      (= (at g
                                                             (fst (snd m))
                                                             (snd (snd m)))
                                                         dc))
                                                    shape-cells)))
                               (if (empty? matches)
                                   acc
                                   (let ((tmpl (fst (first matches)))
                                         (anchor (snd (first matches))))
                                     (let ((dr (- (fst dp) (fst anchor)))
                                           (dcc (- (snd dp) (snd anchor))))
                                       (reduce (lambda (a cell)
                                                 (let ((nr (+ (fst cell) dr))
                                                       (nc (+ (snd cell) dcc)))
                                                   (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                                       (set-cell a
                                                                 nr
                                                                 nc
                                                                 (at g
                                                                     (fst cell)
                                                                     (snd cell)))
                                                       a)))
                                               acc
                                               (obj-cells tmpl))))))))
                         (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) bg))
                         dots)))))))
